generated_by: observed virtme-ng runs on the qualified x86-64 host (recorded by hand)
notes: Both lanes use software emulation (--disable-kvm, TCG). KVM hardware acceleration is not available to unprivileged users on the qualifying host (/dev/kvm is root:kvm without a caller grant), so TCG is the pinned default for every lane.
The runner binary is resolved via PATH at run time; its version and SHA-256 must match this lock. Absolute install paths are intentionally not pinned.

Kernel images are the Ubuntu mainline builds cached by virtme-ng under ~/.cache/virtme-ng/<release>/; the .deb file names and hashes below identify the exact artifacts. A lane whose cache is absent fails the matrix; lanes are never silently skipped.

execution-contract-v1: the runner entry is a console-script stub, so the lock also pins its exec chain (null here: the entry runs directly), the shebang interpreter hash, the first-party package modules, and the emulator image hash. Admission resolves each once and probes versions only after every static check passes.

interpreter.description: console-script interpreter of the uv tool install, resolved via the entry shebang and hash-pinned (install paths are not pinned)

distribution.note: First-party runner modules are hashed per-file above; third-party dependencies, the emulator's dynamic closure and the interpreters' standard libraries are bound to this distribution, not hashed per-file.
